edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom().
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() to gate the transfer before moving balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() for non-allowlisted senders.
approve() writes allowance for msg.sender as owner.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating the allowlist.
constructor sets owner and full supply balance to msg.sender.
delegate() performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary owner-supplied address and calldata.
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
transferFrom() mutates allowance and balanceOf with raw -= / += operations.
init() scales token/maxToken with unchecked multiplication.
ensure() reads tradeAddress from the allowlist comparison.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass sale conditions.
ensure() compares _from and _to against the owner address.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom() checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
condition() reads _saleNum to cap per-address sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
init() writes the computed _minSale value.
init() writes the computed _maxSale value.
init() writes the _saleNum sale cap.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress allowlist entry.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns the entire totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only meaningful inside transfer(), so it collapses into the transfer() function node.
Amount parameter only meaningful inside transfer(), so it collapses into the transfer() function node.
Sender parameter is only used by the ensure() allowlist checks, so it merges into ensure().
Recipient parameter is only used by the ensure() allowlist checks, so it merges into ensure().
Amount parameter is forwarded into condition() for min/max sale checks, so it merges into condition().
Sender parameter drives the allowance and balance updates inside transferFrom().
Recipient parameter drives the balance credit inside transferFrom().
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked subtraction/addition on allowance and balances.
Spender parameter is only meaningful inside approve().
Amount parameter only meaningful inside approve().
Sender parameter selects the _onSaleNum entry read by condition().
Amount parameter is compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Target address parameter is the callee of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter is the payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Sale count parameter is simply stored into _saleNum inside init().
Token parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication token*(10**decimals).
MaxToken parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication maxToken*(10**decimals).
Recipient array parameter only meaningful inside batchSend()'s loop.
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
Address parameter is directly assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress().
Factory parameter is only used in the pure pair derivation of pairFor().
Token parameter is only used for the sorted pair derivation in pairFor().
Token parameter is only used for the sorted pair derivation in pairFor().
Name parameter is directly stored into the name state variable by the constructor.
Symbol parameter is directly stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
Supply parameter directly determines totalSupply and the initial balance mint.
Locally derived pair address is only used inside the ensure() allowlist comparison.
Locally computed total is the result of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
Loop index only controls the iteration of batchSend().
Loop-local recipient only exists to credit balances inside batchSend().
Sorted token local is only used to build the pair hash inside pairFor().
Sorted token local is only used to build the pair hash inside pairFor().
Return local of pairFor() is entirely defined by the pairFor() function node.
